build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: __now when available; otherwise Date.now. Calibration >=50ms, median of seven samples.
order: Three complete 33-case overlap invocations and three complete 3-case control invocations per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 342 final values checked (297 overlap, 27 tag controls, 18 isolated Locale controls). All FormatJS before/after values match; all controls match all hosts. Only overlap comparator differences: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
change: Bounded private cache stores at most 64 successful canonical string results, input/output each <=128 UTF-16 units. Coercion and general list traversal remain per-call; strings and branded Locale inputs return fresh singleton arrays directly. Long strings bypass admission.

isolatedLocaleControl.finding: Mixed-suite Locale diverse/long controls shift slower, while isolated optimized versions reverse direction. Both remain recorded; cause unproven. Native archive and Locale factory source/contrib files compare byte-identical.

cacheOnlyPrototype.finding: Cache alone improved repeated tags but slowed diverse misses and long inputs. Singleton result construction was added as a separately measured step; the final before/after runs include both.

conformance.gates: All 12 Hermes Test262 suites pass existing gates; 21 focused gates pass, including ICU4C/J locale formatting, ICU4C/J/X relative-time matrix and native Locale/List/RTF source/bytecode comparisons.
conformance.observableBehavior: 200 canonicalization checks include mutable object coercion, fresh result arrays, invalid trailing tags, captured Map methods under diverse input, inherited array accessor poisoning and genuine Locale branding.
conformance.consumer: Nine SDK API smoke scripts pass.

limits: Several shared constructor and steady-state gaps remain. No whole-goal completion claim.

commands.benchmark: bazel build -c opt //benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension:overlap_bytecode //benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension:canonical_tag_control_bytecode //benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension:locale_control_bytecode; run each cquery artifact on each pinned optimized host
